items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 26 July 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic and low pressure near Norway as a frontal system affects the British Isles.


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, soon veering west or northwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6, backing west mainly 3 or 4 overnight into tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, then isolated showers soon developing.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West mainly 3 or 4, soon backing southwest 4 or 5.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, then occasional rain or drizzle developing.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
